audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagree with the packet chart and with their own whys: row 0 reads Zac while whys[0] says 'You own level 1'; rows 3 and 5 read Skill while the packet gives both to Zac and whys[3]/whys[5] agree; row 4 reads Zac while whys[4] says level 6 is a window back to you; row 6 reads Zac while whys[6] gives the two-item mark to Vayne.
audit.why: 52.44% over 698 games, with a real level-1 lead, a Zac mid-lane, a level-6 window and a late flip — none of which the chart showed.
audit.corrected: All five rows aligned to the packet chart in both layers, ratings moved with them.
sources: currentText whys[0], whys[3], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage explanation was boilerplate; the level-6 window and the two-item flip — the two spikes this matchup actually turns on — were only in the content layer.
audit.why: Level 6 is Final Hour's Tumble resets letting you leave his leap; two items is Silver Bolts' percent-health true damage beating the health he stacks. The first-item stage is still his because Cell Division's blobs out-sustain a single item.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [3], [4], [5] and [6] .why rewritten with the cooldowns and the real spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d had no cooldowns or ranges, Unstable Matter appears nowhere on the page, and the auto-attack reset that opens his Q was never stated.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s — a huge punish window the page never quantified. Unstable Matter is a flat 5s that deals percent maximum health at 350 range, which is why standing next to him loses even when his engage is spent. Stretching Strikes reaches 800 and is flagged as an auto reset.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten with the numbers, plus Unstable Matter added to phases[3].why.

audit.why: Elastic Slingshot is the right cooldown to track and is now stated as 21s at rank 1.

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Zac contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot does not exist yet — walk him down, stack Silver Bolts, and take the level-1 trade outright.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Elastic Slingshot's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1, but Unstable Matter is 5s and burns percent max health at 350 range. Give ground.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Zac's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Final Hour's Tumble resets and stealth take you out of his leap — your window back, so punish him before the blobs recover.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Elastic Slingshot's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King alone does not beat his health stacking — you need Grievous Wounds on the blobs too.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Zac carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Silver Bolts' true damage ignores his whole health pool and Condemn ends the slingshot against a wall.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge or condemn it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — that gap is your whole lane.

edits.before: Zac wastes Elastic Slingshot — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Condemn only stuns into terrain — fight with a wall behind him.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The leap knocks you up from outside kite range — watch the bush he charges in.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Stretching Strikes reaches 800 and opens on an auto reset — step back.

notes: packet suspectName "Let's Bounce" in spikes[1].text is a FALSE POSITIVE — only the exclamation mark is missing from the real 'Let's Bounce!'; the mirror audit reached the same conclusion and I left it alone. Zac's E carries a 'grounding' derived flag but Riot's text for it says only 'attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward' — no grounding effect is described, so I did not write any claim that it shuts off Tumble.
